""" Web scraper for extracting API documentation from HTML pages. This initial implementation provides basic HTML parsing functionality that will be evolved to handle complex documentation structures. The LLM will have access to actual documentation pages through optillm's readurls plugin, allowing it to understand the specific HTML structure and improve the parsing logic accordingly. """ from bs4 import BeautifulSoup from typing import Dict, List, Optional import re # EVOLVE-BLOCK-START def scrape_api_docs(html_content: str) -> List[Dict[str, any]]: """ Extract API documentation from HTML content. Args: html_content: Raw HTML content of a documentation page Returns: List of dictionaries containing function documentation """ soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, "html.parser") functions = [] seen_signatures = set() # 1. Look for dt/dd pairs (common in Sphinx docs) dt_blocks = soup.find_all("dt") for dt in dt_blocks: sig_text = dt.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in sig_text and ")" in sig_text: # Find associated description in dd sibling dd = dt.find_next_sibling("dd") desc = dd.get_text(strip=True) if dd else "No description found" name = sig_text.split("(")[0].strip() if sig_text not in seen_signatures: seen_signatures.add(sig_text) functions.append({ "name": name, "signature": sig_text, "description": desc[:200] if desc else "No description found", "parameters": extract_parameters(sig_text), }) # 2. Look for function signatures in headers with following paragraphs def extract_function_from_tag(tag, tag_type="header"): """ Helper to extract function details from a given tag. """ text = tag.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text: # Find description desc = "No description found" next_p = tag.find_next("p") if next_p: desc = next_p.get_text(strip=True) return { "name": text.split("(")[0].strip(), "signature": text, "description": desc[:200], "parameters": extract_parameters(text), } return None # Process headers for header_tag in ["h1", "h2", "h3", "h4"]: headers = soup.find_all(header_tag) for header in headers: func = extract_function_from_tag(header) if func and func['signature'] not in seen_signatures: seen_signatures.add(func['signature']) functions.append(func) # 3. Look for code blocks with adjacent descriptions code_blocks = soup.find_all("code") for block in code_blocks: text = block.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text: # Look for description in parent or sibling parent = block.parent desc = "No description found" if parent: # Search for descriptions in multiple related tags next_elem = parent.find_next_sibling() prev_elem = parent.find_previous_sibling() container = parent.find_parent("div") if next_elem: desc = next_elem.get_text(strip=True) elif prev_elem: desc = prev_elem.get_text(strip=True) elif container: desc = container.get_text(strip=True) if text not in seen_signatures: seen_signatures.add(text) functions.append({ "name": text.split("(")[0].strip(), "signature": text, "description": desc[:200] if desc else "No description found", "parameters": extract_parameters(text), }) # 4. Look for pre blocks (code examples) pre_blocks = soup.find_all("pre") for pre in pre_blocks: text = pre.get_text(strip=True) # Split by lines to find function definitions for line in text.split("\n"): if "def " in line and "(" in line and ")" in line: sig = line.strip() if sig not in seen_signatures: seen_signatures.add(sig) name = sig.split("(")[0].replace("def", "").strip() functions.append({ "name": name, "signature": sig, "description": "No description found", "parameters": extract_parameters(sig), }) # Dynamically limit output based on total functions (e.g., top 20% or max 40) max_return = max(10, min(len(functions) // 5, 40)) return functions[:max_return] def extract_parameters(signature: str) -> List[Dict[str, str]]: """ Extract parameter information from a function signature. Args: signature: Function signature string Returns: List of parameter dictionaries """ params = [] # Extract parameters from signature match = re.search(r"\((.*?)\)", signature) if match: param_string = match.group(1) if param_string and param_string.strip(): # Handle nested parentheses and complex types param_parts = [] current = [] depth = 0 for char in param_string + ",": if char in "([{": depth += 1 current.append(char) elif char in ")]}": depth -= 1 current.append(char) elif char == "," and depth == 0: param_parts.append("".join(current).strip()) current = [] else: current.append(char) for part in param_parts: if not part: continue # Extract name, type, and default param_name = part param_type = "unknown" param_default = None # Check for default value if "=" in part: # Handle multiple "=" signs in default values (e.g., param="key=value") split_idx = part.index("=") param_name = part[:split_idx].strip() param_default = part[split_idx + 1:].strip() # Check for type annotation if ":" in param_name: name_part, type_part = param_name.split(":", 1) param_name = name_part.strip() param_type = type_part.strip() else: param_name = param_name.strip() # Clean up name (remove *, **, etc.) param_name = param_name.lstrip("*").strip() if param_name: params.append({ "name": param_name, "type": param_type, "default": param_default, "description": "", }) return params def format_documentation(api_docs: List[Dict[str, any]]) -> str: """ Format extracted documentation into a readable string. Args: api_docs: List of API documentation dictionaries Returns: Formatted documentation string """ output = [] for doc in api_docs: output.append(f"Function: {doc['name']}") output.append(f"Signature: {doc['signature']}") output.append(f"Description: {doc['description']}") if doc.get("parameters"): output.append("Parameters:") for param in doc["parameters"]: param_line = f" - {param['name']}" if param.get('type') and param['type'] != 'unknown': param_line += f" ({param['type']})" if param.get('default'): param_line += f" = {param['default']}" if param.get('description'): param_line += f": {param['description']}" output.append(param_line) output.append("") # Empty line between functions return "\n".join(output) # EVOLVE-BLOCK-END # Example usage and test if __name__ == "__main__": # Sample HTML for testing basic functionality sample_html = """
json.dumps(obj, indent=2)

Serialize obj to a JSON formatted string.

json.loads(s)

Deserialize s to a Python object.

""" docs = scrape_api_docs(sample_html) print(format_documentation(docs)) print(f"\nExtracted {len(docs)} functions")
